families.name: Unit tests
families.guidance: Inspect the unit Vitest project and native test durations. Split or rebalance complete test selections only when the test step is the bottleneck; preserve the unit and base-path coverage checks and failure propagation.

families.name: Integration tests
families.guidance: Inspect integration test durations and fixture requirements before partitioning the selection. Preserve every integration test, emulator-backed behavior and native failure propagation.

families.name: Server tests
families.guidance: Inspect the Mocha server test command and native file durations. Preserve test discovery, required service setup and original failures when splitting or rebalancing the suite.

families.name: Project directory tests
families.guidance: Inspect the canonical project directory, provider, websocket and cloud entrypoint tests. Preserve all four explicitly selected files and their real emulator behavior.

families.name: Chromium E2E tests
families.guidance: Compare native Playwright durations across every Chromium project. Existing new-2, new-3 and tables partitions already have coverage and completion guards; preserve the exact collected selection, browser coverage, artifact identity and failure aggregation. Separate dependency/service startup from test execution before choosing further sharding.

families.name: Firefox E2E tests
families.guidance: Inspect the Firefox selection runner and actual browser execution receipts. Keep Firefox separate from Chromium; preserve its complete curated selection, zero-test rejection and failure evidence when balancing work.
